tips.menu: Try ACT first: see what it likes.
tips.heavy: HEAVY is a smaller mark and a harder hit. Some monsters take it badly.
tips.flee: FLEE gets you out of a fight, at a price. Champions won't let you.
tips.act: CHECK is free. Everything else takes a turn.
tips.mercy: The gold bar is its mercy odds. What you do moves them.
tips.spare: Its name is gold: it will likely accept. Try SPARE.
tips.strike: Press ENTER when the line crosses the middle.
tips.dodge: You are the white diamond. Arrows move it. Stay off what glows.
tips.ask: Friends make every fight easier, and the Last Door needs one.
tips.clans: Monsters talk. Its kin will hear what you just did.
tips.dead: Dying only starts this fight over.
tips.item: Found something. In a fight, ITEM uses it. Hover to read it.
tips.crack: That wall is cracked. Walk into it.
tips.roaming: They move when you move. Turning is free: stop and look.
tips.hunted: It has seen you. It takes a step for every step you take.
tips.lurker: Something stirs. Walk round it, or into it: a fight, and its purse.
tips.request: That one isn't here to fight. Walk up and hear what it wants.
tips.hungry: You are hungry. ENTER makes camp, if you have anything to eat.
tips.boss: Champions change attack every turn. They can be won over too.
